about: Sunday-morning rebuild (8:30 a.m. ET). The simulation was re-run with Friday's final injury report, Saturday's moves, the London inactives and Tyson Bagent starting for CHI. Players who are out are removed, and the next men up get their carries and targets in the numbers. Questionable players are built as playing and flagged. Steelers–Browns is final and graded; its picks stay as they were at kickoff. New this run: sportsbooks have now posted yardage and catch lines, so those picks are measured against the posted line (over or under) instead of a milestone. The model's yardage projections run well below the books' lines for many lead players, so the big under numbers say more about the model than about a sure thing. Inactives for 1 p.m. games come about 11:30 a.m. ET and aren't in this.
bar: Re-run Sunday morning: Jefferson, Keenan Allen, McLaurin and Rachaad White are out of the numbers, and Bagent starts for CHI. Still to come: Evans, McConkey, Coker and Parkinson are questionable (inactives about 90 minutes before kickoff). Yardage picks now use the books' posted lines, which is why unders show up on the board.

pit-cle: Final: Browns 27, Steelers 24 (Andre Szmyt's 56-yard field goal with 10 seconds left). Picks are frozen as they stood at kickoff and graded: 13 of 29 won. None were on the Top plays board.
The model's Under 38.5 lost (51 points) and PIT win lost; CLE +2.5 won. Warren (93 rushing yards), Metcalf, Boston, Concepcion and Fannin hit their yardage lines.
